ABSOLUTE NET LEASE

THIS ABSOLUTE NET LEASE (this "Lease") is made as of January 20, 2026 between Cordwain Holdings VII, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Landlord"), and Ridgeway Fabrication Corp., an Ohio corporation ("Tenant").

1. PREMISES. Landlord leases to Tenant, and Tenant leases from Landlord, the land and the approximately 96,400 square foot industrial building located at 5500 Foundry Parkway, Twinsburg, Summit County, Ohio, legally described on Exhibit A, together with all improvements, fixtures, and appurtenances (the "Premises"). Tenant accepts the Premises in their AS-IS, WHERE-IS condition, with all faults, and Landlord makes no representation or warranty as to their condition or fitness for Tenant's use.

2. TERM. The term begins on March 1, 2026 (the "Commencement Date") and ends on February 28, 2046, a period of twenty (20) years (the "Term"), unless terminated earlier as this Lease provides.

3. RENT.

3.1 Base Rent. Tenant shall pay annual Base Rent of $674,800, payable in equal monthly installments of $56,233.33 in advance on the first day of each month, without notice, demand, abatement, deduction, offset, or counterclaim of any kind.

3.2 Escalation. Base Rent increases by two percent (2%) on each anniversary of the Commencement Date.

3.3 Absolute Net. This Lease is an absolute net lease. Tenant shall pay, as Additional Rent, all costs and expenses of every kind relating to the Premises, including real estate taxes and assessments, insurance premiums, utilities, maintenance, repairs, replacements, capital expenditures, and management. Landlord shall have no obligation of any kind with respect to the Premises, and Tenant's obligation to pay Rent is absolute and unconditional and shall continue without abatement notwithstanding any casualty, condemnation, interruption of services, or interference with Tenant's use.

4. TAXES. Tenant shall pay all real estate taxes and assessments levied against the Premises directly to the taxing authority before delinquency, and shall deliver evidence of payment to Landlord within thirty (30) days after each payment. Tenant may contest any assessment at its own cost, provided it pays the tax as it becomes due or posts security satisfactory to Landlord.

5. UTILITIES. Tenant shall arrange and pay for all utilities serving the Premises in its own name. Landlord is not liable for any interruption in utility service, and no interruption abates Rent.

6. MAINTENANCE, REPAIR, AND REPLACEMENT. Tenant shall, at its sole cost, maintain, repair, and replace every part of the Premises, structural and non-structural, interior and exterior, including the roof, foundation, structural walls, slab, parking areas, landscaping, and all building systems, and shall keep the Premises in good order and condition and in compliance with all applicable law. Landlord has no maintenance, repair, or replacement obligation of any kind.

7. ALTERATIONS. Tenant may make non-structural alterations costing less than $250,000 in the aggregate in any twelve (12) month period without Landlord's consent, provided Tenant notifies Landlord. All other alterations require Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Tenant shall perform all alterations lien-free and in compliance with law, and shall deliver as-built drawings on completion.

8. USE AND COMPLIANCE. Tenant shall use the Premises for light manufacturing, warehousing, and ancillary office use, and for no other purpose without Landlord's consent. Tenant shall comply, at its cost, with all applicable law affecting the Premises or Tenant's use, including the Americans with Disabilities Act and all environmental law, whether the compliance requires structural or non-structural work.

9. ENVIRONMENTAL. Tenant shall not use, store, generate, or dispose of Hazardous Materials on the Premises except in quantities customary for its permitted use and in compliance with law. Tenant shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Landlord against any claim, cost, or liability arising out of Hazardous Materials brought onto the Premises by Tenant or its agents, invitees, or contractors. Landlord retains responsibility for Hazardous Materials existing on the Premises before the Commencement Date, as disclosed in the Phase I report delivered to Tenant.

10. INSURANCE.

10.1 Tenant's Insurance. Tenant shall maintain, at its cost, special-form property insurance on the Premises for full replacement cost, commercial general liability insurance of at least $5,000,000 per occurrence and $10,000,000 in the aggregate, business interruption insurance covering eighteen (18) months of Rent, workers' compensation as required by law, and environmental liability insurance of $2,000,000, each naming Landlord and Landlord's lender as additional insureds or loss payees as their interests appear.

10.2 Waiver of Subrogation. Landlord and Tenant each waive all rights of recovery against the other for loss covered by property insurance, and each shall cause its insurer to endorse a waiver of subrogation.

11. CASUALTY. If the Premises are damaged, Tenant shall restore them to their prior condition at its sole cost, using insurance proceeds and funding any shortfall itself, and Rent shall not abate. Tenant has no right to terminate this Lease on account of casualty.

12. CONDEMNATION. If the whole of the Premises is taken, this Lease terminates and the award belongs to Landlord, except that Tenant may pursue a separate claim for its trade fixtures, moving costs, and business interruption that does not reduce Landlord's award. If less than the whole is taken, this Lease continues without abatement of Rent and Tenant shall restore the remainder.

13. ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING. Tenant may not assign this Lease or sublet any part of the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, except that Tenant may assign to an affiliate or to a successor to substantially all of its assets with a tangible net worth not less than Tenant's on the date of this Lease, on ten (10) days' prior notice. No assignment or sublease releases Tenant from liability.

14. DEFAULT AND REMEDIES.

14.1 Events of Default. Each of the following is an Event of Default: failure to pay Rent within five (5) days after it is due; failure to perform any other obligation within thirty (30) days after written notice, or, if the cure reasonably requires longer, failure to begin within that period and prosecute the cure diligently; and the filing of a bankruptcy petition by or against Tenant that is not dismissed within sixty (60) days.

14.2 Remedies. On an Event of Default, Landlord may terminate this Lease, re-enter and relet the Premises, and recover all damages permitted by law, including the present value of Rent for the remainder of the Term less the fair rental value, using a discount rate equal to the then-current yield on United States Treasury obligations of comparable maturity. Landlord shall use reasonable efforts to relet the Premises as Ohio law requires.

15. LANDLORD FINANCING. This Lease is subordinate to any mortgage now or hereafter encumbering the Premises, provided the mortgagee delivers a subordination, non-disturbance, and attornment agreement in commercially reasonable form under which Tenant's possession is not disturbed so long as no Event of Default exists. Tenant shall attorn to any successor owner and shall deliver an estoppel certificate within ten (10) business days after request.

16. SURRENDER. On expiration or earlier termination, Tenant shall surrender the Premises in good order and condition, broom-clean, with all building systems in working order, ordinary wear and tear excepted, and shall remove its trade fixtures and repair any damage caused by the removal.

17. GENERAL.

17.1 Governing Law; Venue. This Lease is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio. Any action arising out of this Lease shall be brought in the state or federal courts located in Summit County, Ohio.

17.2 Notices. All notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by nationally recognized overnight courier, or by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the addresses stated beneath the signatures.

17.3 Entire Agreement; Amendment. This Lease is the entire agreement between the parties and may be amended only in a writing signed by both.

17.4 Memorandum. Either party may record a memorandum of this Lease at its own cost.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Lease as of the date first written above.
